comments.name: Olga Steinsdóttir
comments.text: Laugavegur is on my bucket list! Did you do it in one go or with stops at the huts? Any advice on the best time of year for the trail?

comments.name: Pedro Alves
comments.text: Fiz o trilho de Skógafoss em junho — a névoa das cascatas ao amanhecer é mágica. Vale muito a pena levantar cedo! Obrigado pela dica Tiago.

comments.name: Claire Dupont
comments.text: We attempted Landmannalaugar in August — the colorful rhyolite mountains are surreal. Pack a proper rain jacket though, weather changes fast!
